# Kindyr

> Kindyr is a free, open-source, ad-free Minecraft launcher for Windows and Linux. It creates and manages instances, installs mods and modpacks from Modrinth, imports .mrpack files and supports Forge, Fabric, NeoForge and Quilt.

## Pages
- [Home (English)](https://kindyrlauncher.pages.dev/en/): overview and features
- [Inicio (Español)](https://kindyrlauncher.pages.dev/es/)
